posts.title: eMudhra weak keys: how Cloudflare patched and what exploitation looks like
posts.summary: Cloudflare details the discovery that eMudhra certificates used extremely weak keys (only four possible values), allowing connections using unpatched certificates to be broken. The post covers how Cloudflare patched quickly, evidence of attempted exploitation, and how much of the Internet remains exposed.

posts.title: Pure KVA: retaining evicted KV caches in host memory and NFS for long-running agents
posts.summary: Pure describes KVA, which keeps evicted KV caches in host memory and NFS-backed storage instead of recomputing them. Restoring cached state is faster than rebuilding, so more long-running agents stay responsive on the same GPU hardware.

posts.title: How to check and configure NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage for your platform
posts.summary: NVIDIA walks through verifying and configuring GPUDirect Storage, which provides a direct data path between GPUs and storage targets. It covers checking platform support and tuning to raise bandwidth and cut latency and CPU use.
